browser_find._note: Markdown search snippets over the accessibility tree, not JSON.

browser_network_request._note: Markdown detail block. 'part' (4 enum values) was probed across all four plus the omitted case - all five return prose, so it selects content, not shape.

browser_network_requests._note: Numbered markdown list, not JSON. 'static' and 'filter' change content volume only.

browser_pdf_save._note: Ack naming the written file under the isolated --output-dir.

browser_snapshot._note: Accessibility tree rendered as markdown/YAML prose, not JSON. Verified against the raw payload.

browser_start_tracing._note: Ack naming trace files written under the isolated --output-dir.

browser_stop_tracing._note: Every response was 'Error: Tracing is not started' - a fresh process per probe means no tracing session survives to stop.

browser_stop_video._note: Returned 'No videos were recorded.' - a real result, not an error: each probe is a fresh process, so no recording from a prior call survives.

browser_take_screenshot._note: Returns a 2-block content list: markdown text plus an image block whose bytes the probe drops ({type, mimeType, has_data}). Media tool - left as Any, no payload modelled.
